# Deep Tutor Pro {{VERSION}}

Deep Tutor Pro {{VERSION}} is a complete rebuild for lecturers: import a curriculum or teacher’s guide and get classes, course units, contact-hour outlines and learning objectives; write lecture notes by contact hour from your own references (Word, PDF, PowerPoint export); set exams, CATs and assignments with marking schemes — in a standard format or copied from a reference paper; keep question banks with solutions; record students’ biodata and marks by year with configurable grading; and solve questions from text, photos, documents or voice with Deep Solve. Every screen of 1.x that only showed demo content has been replaced by working features or removed.

Your work is saved on your device and works offline. Sign in to your DeepTutor server for AI (Gemini, or OpenAI when its key is configured — switchable in Settings), knowledge bases and private cloud sync across your PC and phone.

## Highlights

- **Curriculum import** — PDF (including scanned), Word, PowerPoint or photos; AI analysis you review before anything is created; per-unit topics, hours and objectives extracted in the background.
- **Lecture notes by contact hours**, grounded in your references, with AI revision and Word/PDF/PowerPoint export.
- **Exams & coursework** with topic selection, standard or custom formats, reference-paper format analysis, marking schemes and model answers; question bank with solutions.
- **Students & marks** by year of study: biodata, Excel/CSV import/export, weighted components, grade bands, rankings, statistics, transcripts, class promotion.
- **Deep Solve** with photos, documents and voice notes; tutor chat and Deep Research with sources; knowledge bases.
- **Offline-first** with on-device OCR and exports; cloud sync with conflict review and version history; checksummed backup files.

## Downloads

| File | For |
| --- | --- |
| `Deep-Tutor-Pro-{{VERSION}}-Windows-x64-Setup.exe` | Windows 10/11 (64-bit) installer |
| `Deep-Tutor-Pro-{{VERSION}}-Android.apk` | Android 7.0 or later (install from file) |
| `deep-tutor-pro-web-{{VERSION}}.zip` | Web build: unzip and serve the folder from any static web server |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | Checksums for the files above |

## Notes

- The desktop app now serves its pages from its own `app://tutor-pro` address instead of local files. Work saved by a 1.x desktop install is not carried over automatically.
- Voice notes ask for microphone access the first time you record; no other device permissions are requested.
- To use a DeepTutor server, sign in under **Settings -> Account & server**. Backups can be exported and imported under **Settings -> Sync, backup & data**.
